SMA Negeri 1 Plus Matauli Pandan merupak: SMA Negeri 1 Plus Matauli Pandan is an excellent state school under the MATAULI Foundation and the Ministry of Education and Culture of North Sumatra Province. Founded on June 14, 1994, until 2025 this school has graduated 30 classes with more than 8,000 alumni.
SMA Negeri 1 Plus MATAULI Pandan adalah: SMA Negeri 1 Plus MATAULI Pandan is an excellent state school under the Maju Tapian Nauli Foundation (MATAULI) and the Ministry of Education and Culture in North Sumatra Province. On June 14, 1994, the first class was officially inaugurated by the Commander of the Armed Forces, General TNI Feisal Tanjung and Dr. Ir. Akbar Tandjung, along with national figures from Central Tapanuli.
Menko Polkam: Coordinating Minister for Political & Security Affairs
Jendral TNI. Feisal Tanjung merupakan sa: General TNI Feisal Tanjung was one of Indonesia's important military figures in the journey of the Indonesian National Armed Forces. Born in Tarutung, North Sumatra, on June 17, 1939, he was known as a high-ranking officer with great dedication to serving the nation.
Bapak Jendral TNI. Feisal Tanjung menjab: General TNI Feisal Tanjung served as Commander of the Indonesian National Armed Forces from 1993–1998 under President Soeharto. He then served as Coordinating Minister for Political and Security Affairs of the Republic of Indonesia from 1998–1999 under President B. J. Habibie.
Sebagai tokoh nasional yang berasal dari: As a national figure from North Sumatra, Feisal Tanjung was known for his great concern for regional development and improving human resource quality. He was also known as a figure with strong commitment to supporting educational development for Indonesia's youth, including through the establishment of educational institutions under the MATAULI Foundation in 1991.
Wafat pada 18 Februari 2013 di Jakarta p: He passed away on February 18, 2013 in Jakarta at the age of 73. General TNI (Ret.) Feisal Tanjung was given a military burial at the Kalibata National Heroes Cemetery, South Jakarta, as a tribute to his service and dedication to the nation and state.
Ketua DPR RI: Speaker of the House of Representatives
Dr. Ir. Akbar Tandjung adalah salah satu: Dr. Ir. Akbar Tandjung is one of Indonesia's national figures who played an important role in politics, education, and human resource development. He was born in Sibolga, North Sumatra, on August 14, 1945.
Dalam perjalanan kariernya, beliau menja: Throughout his career, he served as Minister of Youth and Sports of the Republic of Indonesia under President Soeharto from 1993–1998, then as Minister of Public Housing from March–May 1998. He subsequently served as Chairman of Golkar Party and Speaker of the House of Representatives from 1999–2004.
Di luar aktivitas politik, beliau dikena: Outside of political activities, he was known for his great concern for educational development and youth development. This commitment was realized through various social and educational activities, including through the establishment of educational institutions under the MATAULI Foundation in 1991.
